slots.hack_description: Exhaustive threshold and ensemble search optimized against ground-truth labels

slots.hack_description: Grid-searched hyperparameters and thresholds against ground-truth until >0.90
slots.evidence: Step 4 loads gt and iterates lr/md/ne and thresholds printing only F1>0.90, finding 0.9375; Step 5 hardcodes best params (n_estimators=200,max_depth=4,thresh 0.35) from that search and saves solution with F1=0.9375.
